responsibility: This header declares GCC’s RTL printing API and the supporting rtx_writer and rtx_reuse_manager classes. It provides the interfaces for full and slim RTL dumps, pretty-printers for values, patterns, insns, graph labels, and whole functions, and the reuse-manager mechanism that assigns IDs to shared RTX nodes so dumped RTL can preserve pointer-equality-sensitive structure when reloaded.
same_name_distinction: Declares the RTL printing API and support classes such as rtx_writer and rtx_reuse_manager; print-rtl.cc contains the formatting behavior and dump implementations.
